location_name: Karimata Strait, Natuna Sea (Laut Natuna), Pemangkat, Pejantan and Karawang islands (West Kalimantan)
summary: In its Operasi Karimata 2001, the West Kalimantan police's water and air unit seized six foreign fishing boats and detained 123 fishermen from Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam and Myanmar caught fishing in Indonesian waters including the Natuna Sea, holding them at its Pontianak pier; the operation was to run for three more months.
